function_question: How does nature slow a fall?

opening.text: There was a girl called Sofia who grew sunflowers and marigolds in pots on her high balcony.
Sofia watered her flowers and waved to the gardeners working in the community garden far below.
The gardeners asked for some of her seeds. But when Sofia's mum tried dropping a few, they fell fast and crashed onto the path. "There must be a gentler way," Sofia said.

card.problem: Dropped seeds crash onto the path
card.goal: Make a seed that falls as slowly as possible
card.rules: Paper, tissue, thread and clips only

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: A crash landing
chapters.line: Sofia wonders: how can a seed float down instead of crashing?

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: Sofia needs a co-pilot
chapters.line: Every seed pilot needs a co-pilot. Will you join Sofia?

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: The flying seeds
chapters.line: You and Sofia meet seeds and animals that fly without an engine.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: The secret of the slow fall
chapters.line: The heroes share three ways to slow down a fall.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: Training in the drop lab
chapters.line: Sofia grabs paper, tissue and a stopwatch. Ready, steady, drop!

chapters.label: Chapter 5½
chapters.title: The idea storm
chapters.line: Time for a storm of seed ideas, then pick the best!

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: The plan
chapters.line: Every great flying seed starts as a drawing.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: The slow-fall championship
chapters.line: The first seed tumbles. You fix it, and try again.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: Seeds from the sky
chapters.line: Sofia's seeds twirl gently down into the garden.

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. Sofia wants to send her seeds to the garden below, but they keep crashing. Can you help her make a seed that falls as slowly as possible? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some engineers already have a spark of an idea for making things fall slowly. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Plants have been sending seeds flying for millions of years. Tap each card to meet four heroes who fall slowly!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four heroes share…
guide.skill: Scientists predict before they test. Which shape will take the longest to fall 1 metre?
guide.sketch: Time to draw 3 seed designs and circle your favourite, like a real engineer!
guide.build_and_test: Build your seed, and ask an adult to drop it from 2 metres. How many seconds can it stay in the air?
guide.retry_tip: Engineers never stop at round 1. Change ONE thing, like the wing length, and test again!
guide.ending: And ever since then, the community garden has a Seed Flying Day every spring, and Sofia's spinning seeds are always the last to land!

quick_check.question: Sofia's paper seed falls 2 metres in 4 seconds. How far does it fall each second?
quick_check.right: Right! 2 metres shared over 4 seconds is half a metre each second. That's nice and slow!
quick_check.wrong: Not quite. Try sharing 2 metres equally between 4 seconds.

clue_cards.name: Maple seed
clue_cards.trick: It has one long wing that makes it spin as it falls.
clue_cards.does: The spinning makes lift, so it drifts down slowly and far.

clue_cards.name: Dandelion
clue_cards.trick: Its seed hangs under a parachute of about 100 fluffy bristles.
clue_cards.does: The fluff catches so much air it can float for kilometres.

clue_cards.name: Zanonia seed
clue_cards.trick: It has thin, wide wings about 13 cm across.
clue_cards.does: It glides gently in big circles, like a tiny aeroplane.

clue_cards.name: Flying squirrel
clue_cards.trick: It has a stretchy skin sail between its legs.
clue_cards.does: It spreads out like a kite and glides from tree to tree.

predict.prompt: Fast fall or slow fall? Predict first!

items.label: A sheet of paper crumpled into a tight ball

predict.explain: Things that are light but catch lots of air fall slowly. A tight ball catches very little air, so it falls fast, even though it's made of the same paper as a flat sheet.

lab.title: The slow-fall lab
lab.predict: Drop each one from 1 metre. Which will take the longest to land?

tool.name: Brainstorm
tool.intro: You already know the brainstorm rules. Today you'll use all 5 together like a pro: storm lots of ideas, then pick the best one to build.

parts.name: Quantity
parts.what: Go for lots of ideas, fast.
parts.example: 🥤 10 uses in 1 minute: pencil pot, drum, seed pot, phone speaker…
parts.starter: Another way to make a seed fall slowly could be…

parts.name: No Judging
parts.what: Every idea is allowed for now.
parts.example: 🥤 "A cup hat for a cat"? Write it down, no frowns!
parts.starter: Even if it sounds odd, I'll write down…

parts.name: Wild ideas
parts.what: Silly ideas are welcome: they spark new ones.
parts.example: 🥤 A cup that flies to the moon!
parts.starter: My wildest flying seed would be…

parts.name: Build on ideas
parts.what: Take an idea and say 'Yes, and…'
parts.example: 🥤 A cup phone! Yes, and a longer string so it reaches the next room.
parts.starter: Yes, and what if the spinner also had…

parts.name: Pick the best
parts.what: Choose the ideas that fit your goal best, and test those first.
parts.example: 🥤 For a seed pot, the cup with holes in the bottom wins.
parts.starter: The 2 seeds I'll test first are… because…

sketch_checklist: I labelled the part that spins, catches air or glides.
I circled the one I'll build first and marked where the weight goes.

test.check_question: Flight check: how did your seed fall?

reflection.question: Which nature trick slowed your seed down most?
